author: Arcani test fixtures
rationale: Loop fixture (Story 2.7): learn mode, max run time 20 min, length 1200 s, opening 60 s, body 90 s. Theta reference: a 450 Hz carrier amplitude-modulated by the sine envelope at a fixed 4 Hz theta rate, 75 percent AM depth. Gamma PAC layer: a 250 Hz sine carrier amplitude-modulated at a gamma rate that cycles over 30 to 60 Hz every 60 s (center 45 Hz, swing 15 Hz, start phase 0 degrees), a constant 100 percent AM depth, uncoupled. Compile rejects it: /loop/body_s loop body not whole rate cycles (a whole multiple of 60 s (/gamma_pac/rate_cycle/period_s)). Values are placeholders, not starter defaults. A test fixture, not for listening.
